name: run_ledger_open_long_mark_move
description: Open a long with a zero-cost fill, then move the mark up. Unrealized PnL and equity must follow the mark; wallet is untouched by a MARK.
derivation: initial wallet 1000. Event 1 FILL qty=+2 price=100 fee_rate=0 slip=0: exec=100*(1+1*0/1e4)=100; fee=|2|*1*100*0=0; wallet=1000-0=1000; entry=100; mark is set to the fill price 100; unrealized=2*1*(100-100)=0; equity=1000+0=1000. Event 2 MARK mark_price=110: no cash, wallet stays 1000; unrealized=2*1*(110-100)=2*10=20; equity=1000+20=1020. Final: wallet 1000, unrealized 20, equity 1020, realized 0, fees 0, funding 0, position +2.
